customPorts.description: Web server (TCP): web map, server info and the status query

editor.label: Server token (online mode)
editor.description: Online mode: the server token from your account on play.eco (Account > Server Authentication > Generate Token); the account must own Eco. Leave empty to run in offline mode: players switch their game to offline mode to join, and the server is not listed in the server browser.

editor.label: Detailed description
editor.description: The long description in the server browser. No double quotes or backslashes.

editor.label: Listed in the server browser
editor.description: Needs online mode (a server token on the command line). An offline server is never listed.

editor.label: Server category
editor.description: The category the server browser shows the server under.

editor.label: Play times
editor.description: When the community usually plays, e.g. "Weekdays 18-22 UTC". No double quotes or backslashes.

editor.label: Discord invite
editor.description: Shown in the server browser. No double quotes or backslashes.

editor.label: Collaboration
editor.description: How much players must work together (skill costs and specialization).

editor.label: Meteor
editor.description: A meteor threatens the world; players must stop it.

editor.label: Meteor impact (days)
editor.description: Days of game time before the meteor hits.

editor.label: Exhaustion
editor.description: Limits the hours a player can play per day (Exhaustion.eco has the details).

editor.label: Mods (mod.io ids)
editor.description: The mod.io ids (the number under Mod ID on the mod's mod.io page) the server keeps installed, as a list: [4358905, 123456]. Keep [] for none. A mod is installed about a minute after the server starts and loads at the next restart. A mod whose id is removed is uninstalled at the next start.

editor.label: Mod versions
editor.description: For a mod that ships several versions (one per language), which one installs: ["4358905=English"]. Keep [] when not needed.

editor.label: When a mod is missing or has an update
editor.description: Install: the server installs missing mods and updates itself (they load at the next restart). Notify: an admin runs /mods sync.

editor.label: mod.io access token
editor.description: Optional. A token from your mod.io account (mod.io > Access > OAuth) lets the server follow the mods and collections that account subscribes to.

editor.label: Server name
editor.description: Shown in the server browser and on the web map. No double quotes or backslashes.

editor.label: Join password
editor.description: Leave empty for no password. No double quotes or backslashes.

editor.label: Detailed description
editor.description: The long description in the server browser. No double quotes or backslashes.

editor.label: Listed in the server browser
editor.description: Needs online mode (a server token on the command line). An offline server is never listed.

editor.label: Server category
editor.description: The category the server browser shows the server under.

editor.label: Play times
editor.description: When the community usually plays, e.g. "Weekdays 18-22 UTC". No double quotes or backslashes.

editor.label: Discord invite
editor.description: Shown in the server browser. No double quotes or backslashes.

editor.label: RCON password
editor.description: Needed for the panel console commands (RCON tool). Leave empty to turn RCON logins off. No double quotes or backslashes.

script.name: Prepare the Linux server
script.description: Makes EcoServer executable (Steam downloads can lose the bit). Never follows symbolic links.

script.name: Eco query
script.description: Reads the server name and online players from the web server (GET /info on the query port).

script.name: Uninstall removed mod.io mods
script.description: Before each start, uninstalls the mod.io mods the server installed whose id is no longer in the Mods list (Configs/ModKit.eco): Eco only stops following them. Never follows links, never leaves the Mods folder.
